CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting

  July 13, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  •  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 1:
APPLICANT: 2120 West Main Street

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval pending clarification of the west
elevation sign.

The applicants Jennifer Steen, Kimley-Horn and Associates, Inc. was present for Item number 1
and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments.
There were no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting

The applicant stated that the entry elevation and east elevation bullseye have been reduced and
will not extend over the parapet. The revisions are included in the documentation. Chiu clarified
that the revisions were made. She also at the previous DRB approval had expired which is why the
item is before the Board. Tsai clarified that all elevations should not exceed above the parapet.
There were no other Board comments.

MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to approve the application as presented with the clarified
  revisions.
 •  The second was by Stanley Tsai
 •  The motion carried by the following 4-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

  1
 ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Katie Chiu adjourned the meeting at 7:45
 •  Seconded by Nora Hernandez.
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Jose Luis Espinoza, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 9th day of November, 2021.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
